title: Find the next valid local cron hour after a midnight gap
summary: The merged cron returned Cairo's next two even hours on April 25 and New York's next legal midnight and 02:00 on March 9. Both parent schedules skipped a day.

change.description: Both landed commits cover the cron field rollover and its regressions. Preserve later valid matches on the same calendar day when the first local hour does not exist.

notes: Both the civil time and instant are recorded on each successive call. The installed zone rules must contain both named gaps.
